sql-join-main-warehouse-location-type: JOIN linmt.main_warehouse mw ON w.location_type = 'W' AND mw.id = w.location_id WHERE mw.status > 0

sql-left-join-employee-oib-duplicate: LEFT JOIN linmt.employee other_e ON other_e.oib = e.oib AND other_e.id <> e.id AND other_e.status = 1
sql-select-issued-status: SELECT a.id AS aId, pc.id AS pcId, r.catalogue_id AS cId, date(wpa.return_timestamp) AS rDate, 'IZDANO' AS status, COUNT(*) AS quantity

sql-select-written-off-status: SELECT a.id AS aId, pc.id AS pcId, r.catalogue_id, date(wpa.return_timestamp) AS rDate, 'RASHODOVANO' AS status, COUNT(*) AS quantity
sql-select-written-off-sum: SELECT aId, pcId, cId, rDate, 'RASHODOVANO' AS status, SUM(quantity) AS quantity
sql-where-cf-status-location-ids: WHERE (cf.status = 1 OR cf.status = :status) AND cf.id IN (:locationIds) ORDER BY w.location_name

sql-where-mw-status-location-ids: WHERE (mw.status = 1 OR mw.status = :status) AND mw.id IN (:locationIds) ORDER BY w.location_name
